comparison.objective: Remove one terminal, versus inspect a bent tube by seating it in a checking fixture.
comparison.physical_skill: Blade-mediated latch release, versus bimanual level transport and simultaneous four-leg slot insertion.
comparison.success_condition: Terminal exits without damage or neighbor release; versus all four tube legs seated, released, and at rest.
comparison.reason: The record tests distributed multi-point alignment and insertion, not extraction from a latch.
